decisions.statement: A record is put in as the body spells it rather than as a quoted string.
A record field naming a page that is not there refuses the answer.
Where a record falls in the property is worked out by the module this change names.
Text that parses as no record is refused before the body is read.
That refusal shows one record rather than describing the form.
The whitespace around a record is dropped before that record is read or written.
A property holding one value is refused rather than made a list.
A record the property spells already is refused rather than held twice.
A page stating no such key gains that key rather than being refused.
A key is judged before the body is read.
A key spelled as a slug is refused rather than gained under that spelling.
The refusal names the key that spelling makes.
A key that is no bare word is refused rather than gained.
A key the page gains is written after the property `after` names.
An `after` naming no property the page states is refused rather than dropped.
A body exporting no object is refused rather than gaining a key.
The body is answered rather than written.
Nothing here reads the index.
Nothing here reads what the record means.
A record spelling a key with quotes that key does not need is refused.
An `after` stated where the page states the key already is refused rather than dropped.

definition: one record put into one page property in a page's body
